# glovebox-gear — review context

- **What it is:** Glovebox Gear (glovebox-gear.com), a static Amazon-affiliate review site, one of 6 repos in the RVA Digital Works affiliate family that share one formula. 12 HTML pages at repo root plus `assets/main.js`, `assets/styles.css`, `favicon.svg`. No forms, no build step.
- **Affiliate link contract:** every Check Price anchor carries `data-amz="<search phrase>"` and no href (51 anchors; none hard-coded to Amazon). `assets/main.js` defines AFFILIATE_TAG (onam..., 16 chars) at line 5 and, on DOMContentLoaded, sets href to `https://www.amazon.com/s?k=<encodeURIComponent(phrase)>&tag=<AFFILIATE_TAG>`, `target=_blank` and `rel="sponsored nofollow noopener"` (line 16). The tag is identical across all 6 repos. Renaming `data-amz` or dropping main.js leaves the buttons dead.
- **Class contract used by main.js:** `.nav-toggle` toggles `.open` on `.nav-links` (styled as `.nav-links.open` in styles.css). `[data-year]` elements get the current year. Every page loads `<script src="assets/main.js">` by relative path.
- **Signal pixel:** embedded directly as `<script async src="https://signal.rvadigitalworks.com/pixel.js?site=glovebox-gear">` on all pages. There are no `/_v` rewrites here, unlike the other 5 affiliate repos. Site key is `glovebox-gear`. The footer cross-links the five sister sites (kitchen-grade.com, desk-haus.com, paw-pick.com, creator-rig.com, www.trailhead-gear.com).
- **vercel.json:** only a permanent `/index.html` -> `/` redirect. No `cleanUrls` (URLs keep `.html`, matching canonicals and sitemap) and no security headers. The redirect destination is fixed, so there is no open-redirect surface.
- **Public by design / CI:** the Associates tag, IndexNow key 83e5... (32 chars; key file `83e5...txt` at repo root, same key across the audited repos) and `BingSiteAuth.xml`. `.github/workflows/indexnow.yml` runs on push to main/master with `permissions: contents: read`, uses no secrets and no `${{ }}` expressions, and submits changed `*.html` with `CLEAN_URLS=false` for `glovebox-gear.com`.
